title: Structa diagram
description: One diagram for Structa to draw. Text is plain text in Latin letters, digits and common symbols, with no control characters; runs of spaces collapse to one, and text can't be only spaces. Ids must be unique across nodes and edges, and "from" and "to" must name a node.

version.description: the format version; leave it out to mean the current one

direction.description: which way the diagram flows: top to bottom or left to right

nodes.description: the cards, in reading order; the order gently guides the layout

id.description: a unique id made of letters, digits and - _ . :

label.description: the text shown in the shape

status.description: what the change does to this card; leave it out for no status

id.description: a unique id; without one the line is known as edges[N]

from.description: the id of the node the line starts at

to.description: the id of the node the line ends at

status.description: what the change does to this line, shown by its colour; leave it out for no status

emphasis.description: true draws the line thicker, to point out the main path

label.description: the name shown on a card: plain text

description.description: a sentence about a card: plain text

lineLabel.description: a short label on a line: plain text
